subject: Redline walkthrough + onboarding cadence for Starmap Health
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@starmaphealth.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@starmaphealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + MSA redline review & vendor onboarding cadence

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the cost controls. Procurement and legal here at Starmap would like to run a short MSA redline review and align on a 30/60 day onboarding cadence before we sign.

Do you have 45 minutes this week for a walkthrough of our marked MSA and a quick sync to map onboarding checkpoints? We attached our redlines for context.

Quick asks: 
- Please include someone from legal on your side who can talk redlines.
- Include a short agenda and any pre-read.

Attached: Starmap_MSA_marked_v2.docx

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Procurement, Starmap Health
procurement@starmaphealth.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@starmaphealth.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@starmaphealth.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA redline review & vendor onboarding cadence

Hi Sanjay — thanks for sending this over and for the time on the call last week. Happy to run the walkthrough. Proposed times (PST):

- Tue 11/30 9:30–10:15am
- Tue 11/30 3:00–3:45pm
- Wed 12/1 10:00–10:45am

Laura (cc'd) will lead the redline discussion. Jordan will join to capture onboarding milestones and ops requirements.

I've attached a short agenda and suggested attendees. If you prefer a different time, tell me what works and we'll adapt. Also let me know if you want the session recorded and whether Starmap's legal prefers a live screen walkthrough or a line-by-line doc review.

Attachments: redline_walkthrough_agenda_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Lead — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 503-555-0124

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@starmaphealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@starmaphealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA redline review & vendor onboarding cadence

Hi all — Laura here from Legal. I can cover the technical redlines and proposed alternative language. My availability matches the times Ava proposed; my preference would be Tue 11/30 3:00–3:45pm PST to give me time to review your marked doc in the morning.

A short suggested attendee list:
- Starmap: Sanjay (procurement), Maya (legal)
- Redwood: Ava (AM), Laura (Legal), Jordan (CS lead)

Pre-reads I need: the most recent marked MSA (we have the v2 you sent), and any security questionnaire items you anticipate discussing. If you have a prioritized list of clauses (indemnity/data use/retention), include that in a 1-paragraph note so we can triage.

Thanks — I will prepare a redlines tracker and proposed language for any clauses we expect to negotiate.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Chen <maya.chen@starmaphealth.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T18:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA redline review & vendor onboarding cadence

Thanks — Tue 11/30 3pm PST works for us. We prefer a line-by-line review in the meeting; Sanjay will be on the procurement side to confirm commercial asks.

Attached is our internal onboarding checklist (for context) and the marked MSA you already have. We can sign an initial SOW after the MSA is agreed — would Redwood be able to share a sample onboarding plan and milestones during the call?

Attachments: Starmap_MSA_marked_v2.docx, onboarding_cadence_notes.odt

One more ask: we'll need the final MSA on DocuSign once redlines are finalized. If possible, please send a pre-filled envelope after today's session.

—Maya
Maya Chen
Lead Counsel, Starmap Health

From: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@starmaphealth.com>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@starmaphealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA redline review & vendor onboarding cadence

Great — calendar invite sent for Tue 11/30 3:00–3:45pm PST (Google Meet). Agenda attached and I uploaded the current MSA draft and our onboarding template to a shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_starmap_project_redwood

Laura will run the redline walkthrough, Jordan will cover the 30/60 onboarding milestones, and I will capture action items and next steps. Post-call we will:

- Produce a redlines tracker with column for "Redwood response / proposed language"
- Circulate a DocuSign envelope with the agreed MSA (if both legal teams sign off)
- Share a draft onboarding plan and target go-live checklist within 48 hours

If anything changes on your side, please reply-all and we'll reschedule. See you shortly.

Best,
Ava Chen

Redwood Inference
